            /* Observables to submit to Threat Intelligence, as a comma delimited string */

            (

                /* event.data.body.other_observables_key */
                event.data.body.observables

            /* The ** wildcard recursively gets all descendant values, then we filter for strings */

            $strings := [$raw.**][$type($) = "string"];


            /* Finally, join all discovered strings into a comma delimited list */

            $join($distinct([$strings]), ", ") ;
